communication_goal: 补充异常场景与隐含假设，不把测试通过等同于全部正确。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small table and points toward one large checklist sheet mounted upright at center. The sheet has a complete border, four empty square checkboxes and four short blank horizontal lines, with no check marks, letters or numbers. Keep it fully visible and unobstructed. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No other papers or screens.

coverage_review.scope: V032 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V032.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。大型检查清单完整可见，包含四个空框和无文字横线；覆盖率、场景和假设仍是抽象语境词。
